sortedBy: the low end of the 95% interval of the average CLV against Pinnacle's close
rule: Ranked only with 50 picks logged before their start and graded against Pinnacle's own no-vig close at the pick's number, in the league and window shown. Ranked by the low end of the 95% interval of the average CLV, so a short lucky run can't top a long steady one; rows whose low ends match share a rank. Each bettor is judged one app or venue at a time, never pooled. Picks logged after the start (imported histories included) never count.
labelNote: The label is the record's own, from its page: all leagues and all time, never from the slice shown. Proven needs 50 graded, a CLV t of 2 or more and results not running well under what the close expected. No profit, units or stakes here: a record shows units on its own page, and calls them a profit only on a proven kind.
note: No published record has a pick logged before its start and graded against Pinnacle's close in this slice yet.
